name: CyberUserAuthorization
description: Owner-scoped authorization scope and validity record for a general-user CyberAI asset

asset_target.description: Server-captured target snapshot for the asset

scope_ports.description: Bounded port numbers or ranges included in scope

scope_web_paths.description: Bounded web paths included in scope

allowed_testing_methods.description: Bounded defensive testing methods selected by the owner

evidence_reference.description: Bounded internal evidence or approval reference

valid_from.description: ISO start of the owner authorization window

valid_until.description: ISO end of the owner authorization window

status.description: PENDING, ACTIVE, REVOKED, or server-derived EXPIRED state

requested_by.description: Server-derived owner email that created the request

requested_by_user_id.description: Server-derived owner id that created the request

approved_by.description: Server-derived owner email that confirmed the record

approved_at.description: Server timestamp for explicit owner confirmation

revoked_by.description: Server-derived owner email that revoked the record
